name: Sentinel
description: Sentinel watches Jellyfin playback sessions and explains, with evidence, why a specific transcode or playback problem happened — not just that it happened.
overview: Evidence-based root-cause diagnosis for Jellyfin playback problems

versions.changelog: Fixes a bug affecting every previous version: Jellyfin always clears the play method and transcode-reason data on a session before firing the event this plugin used to read them from, so PlaybackEvent rows were recorded with an empty play method and zero transcode reasons regardless of whether a transcode actually happened — confirmed live with a real bitrate-driven transcode that produced a blank database row despite Jellyfin's own dashboard showing an active transcode with a specific reason. Sentinel now also listens to playback-progress events (while that data is still live) and caches it per playback, including a fallback for Jellyfin's own idle-timeout stop path, which never supplies the identifier this plugin would otherwise key on. Verified by three rounds of independent review plus targeted regression tests reproducing the exact real-world event sequence; not yet re-confirmed against a real server for this specific fix.

Adds a minimal read-only dashboard to the plugin's configuration page: recent diagnoses (media, client/device, confidence, explanation) with click-to-expand evidence, backed by a new admin-only API endpoint. Verified by code inspection, two independent review rounds, and a clean local build/test run; not yet independently confirmed against a real server for this specific feature.

Fixes a confirmed bug in 0.1.0.0: installing on a real Jellyfin server resulted in status 'Malfunctioned' because of native SQLite library loading (see build.yaml changelog for the full root cause). Confirmed loading and running correctly on a real Jellyfin 12.1 server. 0.1.0.0 is removed from this list since it is confirmed broken.
